name: Draw and guess
summary: One player sketches a secret word on a canvas while others race to type the answer, with faster guesses earning more.
core_loop: drawer sees word → sketches → guessers type → word revealed on correct guess → roles rotate
scoring: points to guessers by speed and to drawer per guesser
social_hooks: every friend takes a turn drawing
example_prompts: a skribbl with only star wars words

name: Draw something by turns
summary: Players alternate between drawing a word for a friend to guess and guessing the friend's drawing, over days.
core_loop: pick a word → draw → send → friend guesses → friend draws back
rules: drawer picks easy, medium or hard word
example_prompts: draw something with my best friend
async drawing game with a friend

name: Drawing telephone
summary: A phrase passes along a chain where each player alternately draws the previous phrase or describes the previous drawing, and the chain is revealed at the end.
core_loop: get a phrase → draw it → next player describes → next draws → reveal full chain
rules: each player sees only the previous step
win: no win state: the game ends when the player finishes, saves or shares the result
scoring: no score; friends react to or vote on the result
example_prompts: drawing telephone with harry potter prompts

name: One-line drawing
summary: Draw a recognizable prompt without lifting a finger, with judging by friends or a recognizer.
core_loop: see prompt → draw in a single stroke → submit → vote or auto-score
example_prompts: draw a cat in one line
one stroke challenge with my friends

name: Blind drawing
summary: The canvas hides strokes while the player draws a prompt, then reveals the result.
core_loop: see prompt → draw blind → reveal → share

name: Trace the shape
summary: Trace a shape or draw a perfect form and earn a score for how close the stroke is to the target.
core_loop: see shape → trace or draw → compute similarity → score
rules: score from distance of stroke to target

name: Draw from memory
summary: A reference image shows briefly, then hides, and the player draws it from memory and is compared to the original.
core_loop: see image 5 s → hidden → draw → compare

name: Doodle recognizer race
summary: The player draws prompts and a recognizer tries to name it before time ends.
core_loop: see prompt → draw → recognizer guesses → next
example_prompts: an AI that guesses my doodles
draw prompts and the computer guesses

name: Complete the scribble
summary: A random scribble is shown and the player adds to it to make a creature or scene, shared for votes.
core_loop: see scribble → draw additions → share → vote
example_prompts: complete the scribble with my friends

name: Color by number
summary: Tap numbered regions to fill with matching colors and reveal a picture.
core_loop: pick color → tap matching numbers → complete image
scoring: no score; friends react to or vote on the result
example_prompts: color by number of our group photo

name: Pixel art canvas
summary: Draw on a small pixel grid with a limited palette, optionally with a prompt or theme.
win: no win state: the game ends when the player finishes, saves or shares the result
scoring: no score; friends react to or vote on the result

name: Coloring book
summary: Tap regions of a line drawing to fill with chosen colors.
win: no win state: the game ends when the player finishes, saves or shares the result
scoring: no score; friends react to or vote on the result
example_prompts: coloring book with my friends' names

name: Shared canvas
summary: A big canvas that every member can paint on, one pixel or stroke at a time, with cooldowns.
win: no win state: the game ends when the player finishes, saves or shares the result
scoring: no score; friends react to or vote on the result
example_prompts: a place canvas for our group

name: Fold-over drawing
summary: A creature is drawn in segments by different players who see only a sliver of the previous section.
core_loop: draw head → hide → next draws body → hide → next draws legs → reveal
rules: each sees only a few pixels
win: no win state: the game ends when the player finishes, saves or shares the result
scoring: no score; friends react to or vote on the result

name: Sticker scene builder
summary: Drag stickers onto a backdrop to make a scene matching a theme.
win: no win state: the game ends when the player finishes, saves or shares the result
scoring: no score; friends react to or vote on the result
example_prompts: make a space scene with stickers

name: Dress-up creator
summary: Combine hair, outfit and accessories to style a character matching a theme and share it.
win: no win state: the game ends when the player finishes, saves or shares the result
scoring: no score; friends react to or vote on the result
example_prompts: dress up a character in a halloween theme
avatar maker for my friend group

name: Monster mixer
summary: Mix heads, bodies and limbs into a creature that fits a theme or fights.
core_loop: swap parts → compare stats → name it
win: no win state: the game ends when the player finishes, saves or shares the result
scoring: no score; friends react to or vote on the result
example_prompts: create a creature for our team mascot

name: Caption vote
summary: A drawing is shown and players write captions then vote.
example_prompts: funniest caption wins for our group doodles

name: Symmetry draw
summary: Draw strokes that repeat around a center or across a mirror to make patterns.
win: no win state: the game ends when the player finishes, saves or shares the result
scoring: no score; friends react to or vote on the result

name: Spirograph pattern maker
summary: Select gears or nails and watch curves form, then adjust to make a pattern.
win: no win state: the game ends when the player finishes, saves or shares the result
scoring: no score; friends react to or vote on the result

name: Color mixing target
summary: Mix base colors in amounts to match a target swatch.
core_loop: see target → adjust sliders → submit → score

name: Palette from the scene
summary: Pick colors from a scene to match a palette.
example_prompts: pick the colors from this image
match the colors of a sunset photo

name: Tangram builder
summary: Arrange shapes to fill an outline.

name: Pottery wheel
summary: Use finger pressure on a spinning clay form to shape a vase, then glaze and display it.
win: no win state: the game ends when the player finishes, saves or shares the result
scoring: no score; friends react to or vote on the result

name: Draw to protect
summary: The player draws a barrier to protect a character from hazards, such as bees, for a few seconds.
core_loop: see hazard → draw shield → hazard simulates → survive

name: Draw your vehicle
summary: Players draw a vehicle shape that then drives over terrain.
example_prompts: draw a car that climbs hills

name: Draw a ramp
summary: Draw lines so a ball rolls into a target.
example_prompts: draw a line for the ball
draw a ramp so the ball reaches the star

name: Missing piece
summary: A picture is missing an element, and the player draws or places it.
core_loop: see picture → add the missing piece → verify
example_prompts: spot what is missing in the picture and draw it

name: Letter tracing
summary: Trace letters or characters with stroke order and get scored.

name: Build a face
summary: Assemble facial features to match a description or a friend.

name: Speed sketch round
summary: Draw the prompt fast, then share for votes.
example_prompts: 30 second sketch battle with the group chat

name: Prompt the picture
summary: A target picture is shown and players write a short prompt for an image generator; the closest result wins.
core_loop: see target → write prompt → image generated → compare
example_prompts: write a prompt to match this picture

name: Meme maker
summary: Pick a template and caption it, then share for votes.
core_loop: pick template → type captions → submit → vote
example_prompts: make a meme about monday mornings

name: Comic strip builder
summary: Fill three panels with art, speech and characters to tell a short story.
core_loop: pick panels → place sprites → write lines → share
win: no win state: the game ends when the player finishes, saves or shares the result
scoring: no score; friends react to or vote on the result
example_prompts: make a three panel comic about our trip
three panel comic about my cat

name: Dot to dot
summary: Connect numbered dots in order to reveal a picture.
example_prompts: connect the dots to reveal a dinosaur

name: Shapes-only drawing
summary: Draw a prompt using only a given set of shapes.
example_prompts: draw a house with only triangles
draw a castle with only circles
draw my dog using only squares

name: Decorate the room
summary: Decorate a room to match a style brief and have friends vote.
core_loop: read brief → place furniture → submit → vote
example_prompts: decorate a cozy room with a theme
decorate a haunted house room for halloween

name: Photo scavenger hunt
summary: Take photos matching a list of prompts within a time, such as something red.
example_prompts: photo scavenger hunt with my roommates
scavenger hunt where we photograph things that are yellow

name: Story chain
summary: Each player adds one line to build a story together.
scoring: no score; friends react to or vote on the result
example_prompts: build a story with my friends line by line
one sentence each story with my roommates
write a spooky story with friends one line at a time
